chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Saʿīd, from Aḥmad ibn Abī Bishr, from Bakr ibn Karib al-Ṣayrafī, who said:

I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “With us is that by which we have no need of the people, while the people are in need of us. And with us is a book dictated by Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and written in the hand of ʿAlī عليه السلام, a scroll in which is every halal and haram. And indeed, you come to us with matters, and we know when you act upon it, and we know when you leave it.”

key_terms.إِمْلَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: dictation of Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, showing prophetic origin
key_terms.حَرَامٍ: that which is forbidden in the Sacred Law
key_terms.حَلَالٍ: that which is permissible in the Sacred Law
key_terms.خَطُّ عَلِيٍّ: the handwriting of ʿAlī عليه السلام, showing direct recording by the Imam
key_terms.صَحِيفَةً: a scroll or parchment containing preserved teachings
key_terms.عِنْدَنَا: in our possession; indicating exclusive custodianship of knowledge
key_terms.كِتَابًا: a written book containing transmitted religious knowledge

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the knowledge and religious authority of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام possess divinely guided knowledge inherited from Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم through a written source recorded by Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام. It emphasizes their religious authority in matters of halal and haram and indicates that people are in need of their guidance.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Saeed, from Ahmad Bin Abu Bishr, from Bakr Bin Karb Al Sayrafi who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘With us<sup>asws</sup> is that so with it we<sup>asws</sup> would not be needy to the people, and the people would be becoming needy to us (what is therein), and that with us<sup>asws</sup> is a book dictated by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and written by Ali<sup>asws</sup>. A Parchment wherein is every Permissible and Prohibition, and you all are coming to us<sup>asws</sup> with the matter, so we<sup>asws</sup> recognise when you take with it and we<sup>asws</sup> recognise when you are leaving it’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn Sa‘id from Ahmad ibn abu Bishr from Bakr ibn Karib al-Sayrafi who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.

“With us there are such things that because of which we do not become need to people instead people need us. With us there is a book that the Messenger of Allah had dictated and Ali (a.s.) had written it down. It is a book. In it there are all laws of lawful and unlawful matters. You come to us with A number of our people has narrated from issue and we know when you follow the guidance and when you disregard it.”
